name: research-in-a-box
description: Claude Code plugins for a research-in-a-box data archive.

plugins.name: research-archive
plugins.description: Find and fetch data in a research-in-a-box archive, check and fix a dataset package with the archive's own checks, submit it, and review submissions as a curator. Bundles the archive's MCP server and three skills: find-data, submit-dataset and review-submission.
